request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; architecture assessment by Q3 2027; IOG contract stated as closing August 31, 2026
deliverables: Protocol maintenance, node and wallet backend updates, dependency updates, security patches, platform compatibility, and release engineering for Daedalus
Hard fork readiness with compatible stable releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Leios, Peras, and Nested Transactions readiness as those protocols progress
Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, plus newer hardware wallet models as they emerge
CIP-30 dApp connector implementation within Daedalus
User support across GitHub, community forums, and direct channels, including Japanese-language support and full Japanese translation
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
Independent financial audit and test hardware acquisition
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc., with funds administered by Intersect before monthly disbursement to Se7en Labs
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Daedalus Wallet Maintenance and Improvements 2026-2027 delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet and derives wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus private keys are generated and stored on the user's device and are never transmitted to an external service, with source code auditability under Apache License 2.0.
Opt-in telemetry shows approximately 4,000 monthly active Daedalus users, while the true count is asserted to be meaningfully higher.

Se7en Labs assumed responsibility for Daedalus under an IOG contract in January 2026 and shipped Mithril Snapshot Bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, the drt release CLI, and Nix build modernization.
The proposal requests 1,785,333 ADA, consisting of 1,666,667 ADA for labor, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and a 52,000 ADA Intersect administration fee.
The proposer says any unspent labor, hardware, or audit budget will be returned to the treasury.
The funded work will maintain all official Daedalus releases as cryptographically signed through an IOG binary signing arrangement.
All release-timing and version-currency success metrics are claimed to be independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.
The requested withdrawal is claimed not to breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

Intersect is proposed to administer funds, verify milestones, hold withdrawn funds in a dedicated auditable account, and disburse monthly against verified work using treasury management smart contracts with external oversight.

summary: The document asks for 1,785,333 ADA for a 2026-2027 time-and-materials Daedalus maintenance and improvement program covering protocol compatibility, security and dependency maintenance, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, user support, Japanese localisation, and an architecture assessment, with Intersect administration and milestone-based disbursement.
